$comment: Answer key for the Figma Comparison agent (id figma-design-diff) on the Orbit test site. One entry per mapped page path. Buggy paths list every seeded difference; clean paths must produce no findings at all. A finding matches an expected item when its metadata.figmaDiff.issue is one of `match.issues`, its metadata.figmaDiff.designName is one of `match.designLayers` (when given) and its expected/actual text contains `match.textIncludes` (when given). Verified before publishing by running the comparison engine locally against the pages and the frames: every detectable item below was produced, and nothing else except the listed known noise.

engineTolerances.textMatch: design and page text are paired when their similarity is at least 0.6; a pair is identical only when the rendered strings are equal
engineTolerances.typography: size max(1px, 6%); weight differences of 200 or more; line height max(2px, 10%); letter spacing 0.5px; family by canonical name
engineTolerances.colour: CIEDE2000 above 2 (low), above 5 (medium), above 10 (high); text of matched pairs, and backgrounds only for design boxes covering at least 2% of the frame
engineTolerances.layout: after removing the median vertical shift: position max(8px, 2% of the viewport width) (28.8px at 1440, 8px at 375); height max(6px, 10%); reading order needs 3 or more elements out of order; auto-layout gaps max(8px, 25%) between adjacent children that are text or image layers
engineTolerances.assets: matched by overlap (IoU 0.4) or nearby centre; aspect ratio difference above 8%
engineTolerances.ignored: clock times, dates, standalone prices and counters, cookie and consent text

design.text: Start your 30-day free trial and ship reviews faster.

page.text: Start your 14-day free trial and ship reviews faster.

expected.note: Similarity is about 0.96, so the pair is matched and reported as a mismatch rather than missing plus extra.
Medium, not high: the line is 14px, below the 20px heading threshold. The hero has a fixed height, so nothing else moves.

expected.summary: Extra announcement bar above the nav

page.text: New: AI summaries for every project update

expected.note: Page-only text of 4 or more words is reported as extra (info severity). The 40px bar pushes the whole page down; the layout check removes that shift. The model may drop an info-level extra, which would show as a miss.
14% smaller: above the 6% tolerance, below the 25% medium threshold. Line height stays 64px and the title stays on two lines, so its box does not change.

expected.summary: Feature card titles weight 400 instead of 600
expected.note: The three identical differences are grouped into one finding with count 3.

expected.summary: Testimonial quote set in Inter instead of Playfair Display
expected.note: The quote wraps to two lines in both fonts, so the family change does not move anything.

expected.summary: Nav Get started button background #7C3AED instead of #4F46E5
expected.note: KNOWN ENGINE GAP. Background colours are compared only for design boxes covering at least 2% of the frame; this button is about 0.14% (107x40 of 1440x2180). The label text colour is unchanged, so no candidate exists and the model cannot report it. If the engine ever compares small boxes, expect color.background with delta-E about 6.5 (medium).
Delta-E about 20.6. The eyebrow is also an uppercase trap (text-transform on the page, textCase UPPER in the frame).
64px is beyond the 28.8px position tolerance at 1440. Button labels are compared by their centre (they are centred text layers).

Expected as four layout.position findings (the swapped titles and texts move by hundreds of px). layout.order is also acceptable but will not normally fire: text rows are read left to right per row, so only two elements are out of order and the order check needs three.

PARTLY AN ENGINE GAP. The auto-layout spacing check only measures gaps between direct children that are text or image layers; the Features row's children are card frames, so layout.spacing is not produced. The gap change is still visible as the icons in card slots 2 and 3 sitting 40px and 80px to the right (layout.position, confidence 60, matched by nearby centre). The swapped titles and texts belong to (j).
Low because it is an icon, not an image. The empty slot keeps its size, so the title and text do not move.
Aspect 1.5 against 2.0 (25% off, above the 8% tolerance). The same asset pair also produces layout.size, listed under alsoAcceptable.

alsoAcceptable.note: The squashed illustration is also 80px shorter than the design box.

knownNoise.note: KNOWN ENGINE NOISE. Background counterparts are found by overlap without removing the page-wide vertical shift, so the design's white 73px Nav bar overlaps the new dark 40px announcement bar more than the real nav (IoU 0.55 against 0.29) and is reported as #ffffff against #111827. The nav itself is unchanged. Expect this until background matching accounts for the shift.

expected.summary: Pro plan description says small teams instead of growing teams
expected.note: Similarity about 0.68, just above the 0.6 pairing floor.

Grouped into one finding with count 3 (any of the three layers may be named). The three elements share data-testid values, so the finding must still pin to a unique selector. Line height stays 28px, so nothing moves.
Delta-E about 6.5 (medium). The card covers about 7.4% of the frame, above the 2% needed for a background comparison.

expected.summary: Mobile hero CTA says Start trial instead of Start free trial
expected.note: Similarity about 0.69. The CTA band further down still says Start free trial on both sides and must pair with itself.
Low because it is an icon. The empty button keeps its size.

traps.summary: Clock time differs between page and frame
traps.why: Clock times are dynamic text and are excluded from matching.

traps.summary: Standalone price differs between page and frame
traps.why: A string that is only a price is dynamic text and is excluded.

traps.page: three elements each with data-testid="plan-card" and data-testid="plan-name"
traps.why: Selectors must be unique; nothing may be reported about the repetition itself, and (o) must be one grouped finding.

traps.page: Sign in (text-transform: uppercase, renders SIGN IN)
traps.why: Case is compared as rendered; both render SIGN IN. Same for the WHY TEAMS SWITCH eyebrow on every Home frame.

traps.summary: Rich text with an inline link
traps.page: Read the full story on our blog. / See our billing guide for details.
traps.design: one text layer with a coloured, underlined range (mixed style)
traps.why: The sentence is one text run on the page and one layer in the design; mixed-style layers are skipped for typography.

traps.page: body colour oklch(0.21 0.034 264.665) inherited by every heading
traps.why: The engine converts CSS Color 4 values to sRGB; they are the same colour.

traps.page: testimonial section at opacity 0 until an IntersectionObserver adds .is-visible
traps.why: The capture reveals and pins it while scrolling; its text must be found, not reported missing.

traps.page: Start free trial (hero and CTA band), Orbit (nav and footer), Product and Pricing (nav and footer)
traps.why: Identical strings must pair with the nearest counterpart, not with each other.
